sql:
SELECT
    p.PromotionType,
    sum(x.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscountAmount
FROM
(
    SELECT PromotionKey, DiscountAmount
    FROM retail.FactSales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT PromotionKey, DiscountAmount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
) AS x
INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p
    ON x.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
GROUP BY p.PromotionType
ORDER BY TotalDiscountAmount DESC
